desc: Analyze the operation on four consecutive pieces and translate it into swapping gap positions i and i+2 (gaps (p,q,r) -> (r,q,p)).
Prove reachable transformations: same-parity gap positions are independently fully permutable via adjacent transpositions.
Express the final coordinate sum as N*X_1 + sum_t (N-t)*g_t, with gap position t weighted by coefficient N-t.
Derive the optimal assignment via rearrangement inequality: pair larger gaps with smaller coefficients within each parity class.
Implement O(N log N) parity-grouping + sort + dot-product solution; passed both public samples (21 and 41) and matches brute-force reasoning.
